headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when the AEW World Trios Titles had a new owner by the end of the night as House of Black vs. The Elite battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.63 ? an incredible outing ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of House of Black's career. It was the 10th time the AEW World Trios Titles had been on the line, a notable milestone for the title. House of Black isolated Matt Jackson from his stablemates and hit Dante's Inferno to dethrone The Elite, becoming the third-ever AEW World Trios Champions.

Rewind to 2022, when Adam Page vs. Adam Cole clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.27 ? an excellent showing. It was the first title opportunity of Adam Cole's career. A hard-fought main event between two Adams, settled only after Dark Order evened the odds and Page connected with the Buckshot Lariat, on the same card as CM Punk and MJF's brutal, bloody Dog Collar classic.
That Wednesday in 2025, King & Strickland didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.24 ? a well-worked match.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, MJF vs. Bryan Danielson clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in an Iron Man (60 Minutes) match, appearing on Revolution, rated 9.63 ? an all-timer. MJF outlasted Danielson in a bloody 60-minute Iron Man Match, 4 falls to 3, in one of the most acclaimed championship matches in AEW history.

That Saturday in 2022, Jurassic Express vs. reDRagon vs. The Young Bucks went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.58 ? an incredible outing. It was the first title opportunity of reDRagon's career. A tag team spectacle with real internal tension ? reDRagon and the Young Bucks' uneasy alliance kept cracking throughout, before Jurassic Express finally survived the three-way war to retain their titles.

On this day in 2023, the AEW TNT Title found a new home as Wardlow vs. Samoa Joe battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 5.16 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. Wardlow attacked Joe the moment the bell rang, and the two traded hoss offense until Wardlow sunk in a rear naked choke to win his first TNT Championship.
